key.name: ssh-user
key.description: User name to connect as when opening a Tailscale SSH session. Empty means the local user name.

key.name: terminal-command
key.description: Command used to open an SSH session, with the command to run appended as trailing arguments. Empty means auto-detect.

key.name: show-offline-devices
key.description: List devices that are currently offline alongside online ones.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show a Tailscale icon in the top bar while connected.
